fullContentHtml:
Download App Get Started for Free

CG Vyapam Pre BEd Result 2026 is out on 17th July 2026 at vyapamcg.cgstate.gov.in for the CG Vyapam Pre BEd exam conducted on 11th June 2026. Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board (CG Vyapam/CGPEB) has declared the CG Vyapam Pre BEd Result 2026 for candidates who had appeared for the Pre B.Ed Entrance Examination 2026. They can download their CG Vyapam Pre BEd scorecard from the official website. CG Vyapam has also released the final answer key after considering the objections raised against the provisional answer key along with the result. Eligible candidates will now be taking part in the CG B.Ed Counselling 2026 process for admission into B.Ed colleges across the state of Chhattisgarh.

CG Vyapam Pre BEd Result 2026 Out

CG Vyapam BEd Result 2026 is released on 16 July 2026. The final answer key has been prepared after considering all the objections received on provisional answer key, it is informed in the official notice. Candidates can now login with their registered credentials to check their marks and qualifying status from the official CG Vyapam portal. Refer to the table below for quick highlights.

Particular Details
Exam Name CG Vyapam Pre B.Ed Entrance Exam 2026
Conducting Body Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board (CG Vyapam/CGPEB)
Course Bachelor of Education (B.Ed) Admission
Result Status Released
Result Date 17 July 2026
Exam Date 11 June 2026
Provisional Answer Key 25 June 2026
Objection Window 25–30 June 2026
Final Answer Key 16 July 2026
Mode of Result Online
Official Website vyapamcg.cgstate.gov.in

CG Vyapam Pre BEd Result 2026 Download Link

The CG Vyapam Pre BEd Result 2026 has been declared and is now available for download on the official website vyapamcg.cgstate.gov.in. Candidates can download the scorecard using their registered mobile number/User ID and password. The scorecard will have the marks secured, rank, qualifying status and candidate particulars.

CG Vyapam Pre BEd Result 2026 Direct Link

How to Download CG Vyapam BEd Result 2026?

Here are the direct steps to download the CG Vyapam Pre BEd 2026 result. Candidates can download their scorecard by following these steps:

  1. Visit official CG Vyapam website, vyapamcg.cgstate.gov.in
  2. Click on Result from the top menu bar
  3. Click CG Vyapam Pre BEd Result Button.
  4. Enter your registered Mobile Number and Password
  5. Click on login button
  6. The scorecard will appear on the screen.
  7. Download and print the result for future admission rounds

CG Vyapam Pre BEd Result 2026 Important Dates

The schedule of CG Vyapam Pre B.Ed admission is provided below. Candidates should keep checking the official website for counselling dates now.

Event Date
Notification Released March 2026
Online Application Started March 2026
Last Date to Apply April 2026
Admit Card Release 1 June 2026
Entrance Examination 11 June 2026
Provisional Answer Key 25 June 2026
Answer Key Objection Window 25–30 June 2026
Final Answer Key 16 July 2026
Result Declaration 16 July 2026
Counselling To be Announced

CG Vyapam Pre BEd Score List 2026 Out

Chhattisgarh Professional Examination Board has also released the CG Vyapam Pre BEd 2026 Score List PDF. The list includes names of the candidates with category, roll number and application number. The score list contains the names of 62022 candidates. Click on the link below to download the PDF.

CG Vyapam Pre BEd Score List 2026 PDF – Click to Download

Details Mentioned on CG Vyapam Pre BEd Scorecard 2026

The CG Vyapam Pre BEd result scorecard will contain important details related to the candidate and their score. For example;

  • Candidate’s Name
  • Roll Number
  • Registration Number
  • Father’s Name
  • Category
  • Date of Birth
  • Marks Obtained
  • Total Marks
  • Rank
  • Qualifying Status
  • Examination Name

CG Vyapam Pre BEd Final Answer Key 2026

The CG Vyapam Pre BEd Final Answer Key 2026 was also released on July 17, 2026. The board prepared the final key after going through objections submitted by candidates against the provisional answer key. This final answer key has been prepared on the basis of this result only.

CG Pre BEd Counselling 2026

The candidates who qualify in the entrance examination will be called for the CG Vyapam counselling process. The process of counselling typically includes:

  • Online Registration
  • Choice Filling
  • Merit List Publication
  • Seat Allotment
  • Document Verification
  • Admission Confirmation
  • College Reporting

CG Vyapam Pre BEd Qualifying Marks 2026

In the official notice, there is no mention of any separate CG Vyapam Pre BEd qualifying marks for entrance examination. Admission will be on merit, category-wise rank, availability of seats and counselling rules notified by competent authority.

CG Vyapam Pre BEd Result 2026 FAQs

Q1: Is CG Vyapam Pre BEd Result 2026 declared?

Yes. CG Vyapam Pre BEd Result 2026 was declared on 16 July 2026.

Q2: How can the candidates access their CG Vyapam Pre BEd result?

The result of the candidates can be accessed from vyapamcg.cgstate.gov.in.

Q3: When did the CG Pre BEd 2026 entrance exam take place?

The examination took place on 11 June 2026.

Q4: Is CG Vyapam Pre BEd final answer key released?

Yes. The final answer key has been released simultaneously with the release of the result.

Q5: What would happen next after the CG Vyapam Pre BEd result?

Qualified candidates will go through the CG Pre B.Ed counselling procedure.
